h.select_rule: Keep hypotheses you rate at least 55% likely true but expect other models to rate below 50%, and name the specific naive reasoning that would mislead them. Drop anything you rate below 50% yourself, and anything obvious from structure alone. Keep fields and directions diverse.
h.strategy: Propose a broad, varied set of conditional hypotheses covering many different edited fields, conditioning fields and both directions. For each, briefly note your own probability that it holds and how an intuitive reader would judge it.

hyps.why: Removing the direct skip loses the key residual path, which is costly.
A residual shortcut replacing nothing adds trainability, unlike replacing a conv.
Adding any parameter-free path to an empty edge helps more than replacing a stronger op with pooling.
Skip on an empty edge adds a path, while it replaces a stronger op otherwise.
Skip helps less when a conv path already exists.
A direct skip already supplies a good path, so extra conv adds less.
With fewer alternative paths into the output, a skip is more valuable.
Cutting edge 0 makes the downstream conv on edge 4 useless, losing that path.
Cutting edge 1 makes the conv on edge 5 unreachable from the input.
Deleting a conv is more harmful than deleting a pool or skip.
